Miles & More

The frequent flyer and awards programme of ITA Airways

ITA Airways passengers can enjoy all the benefits offered by Europe’s leading frequent flyer and awards programme. Earn miles in the air and on the ground, and redeem them for flights, upgrades and other exciting rewards. You can also earn Points towards Miles & More status levels, and take advantage of even more exclusive benefits and privileges.

Explore the travel benefits for frequent flyers

As a Frequent Traveller, Senator or HON Circle Member, you travel faster and in greater comfort. Enjoy a range of privileges that make your journey even more pleasurable.

Frequent Traveller

Your benefits

From 650 Points + 325 Qualifying Points per calendar year

  • Get a warm welcome at the Business Class check-in
  • Relax in the Business Lounge before departure at many airports
  • Gain access to a special service hotline
  • Your miles do not expire
  • Earn 25% additional miles with every flight

See all Frequent Traveller benefits

Senator

Your benefits in addition to Frequent Traveller status

From 2,000 Points + 1,000 Qualifying Points per calendar year

  • Booking guarantee in the highest booking classes up to 48 hours prior to departure and second-highest waiting list priority
  • Enjoy a warm welcome at First Class or Premium check-in
  • Relax before departure in the Senator and Star Alliance Gold Lounges
  • You’ll receive 2 upgrade vouchers
  • Enjoy a higher free baggage allowance
  • Your checked-in baggage is given priority

See all Senator benefits

HON Circle Member

Your benefits in addition to Senator status

From 6,000 HON Circle Points per calendar year

  • Booking guarantee in the highest booking classes up to 24 hours before departure
  • Enjoy the highest waiting list priority
  • Relax in the comfort of the HON Circle Lounges or First Class Lounges
  • Your partner receives a Senator partner card
  • You’ll receive 4 upgrade vouchers

See all HON Circle benefits
